scope: Windows x64 pre-release for outside testers, with the recorded evidence and disclosed support limits

See RELEASE_DECISION.md. Previous accepted 0.4.0 binaries: dudel.exe D18964FD...069242B5, dudel_thumbnails.dll DE919FF4...1CF7BA34.
